parameters.name: DatabaseIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the database instances that you want to move. This parameter is a JSON-formatted string. You can specify up to 100 database instance IDs. Separate multiple database instance IDs with commas (,).

> You can call the [ListDatabases](~~2758822~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the project to which the database instances currently belong.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: TargetProjectId
parameters.description:
The ID of the target project to which you want to move the database instances.
> You can call the ListProjectsForProjectAuthorizationPrincipal operation to query this parameter.
